title: SightLine node event v1
description: Every event published by a SightLine node (real or simulated) on sightline/<site>/<node>/event. (c) 2026 Ryan Brown / SightLine. Proprietary.

ts.description: ISO 8601, simulated or real wall clock at the node

track_id.description: Node-local track id. Cross-node identity is the correlator's job.

attributes.description: Free-form classifier attributes (color histogram bins, carried-object flags). Input to re-ID.

bearing_deg.description: Bearing from node boresight, positive clockwise

pitch_deg.description: Downward pitch node to target head height

px_per_m.description: Horizontal pixel density at target, best channel

channel.description: Which sensor produced the best frame

pos.description: Site-frame target position in meters (sim always fills this; real nodes fill it when calibrated)

thumb_ref.description: Path or URL to the thumbnail for this event

clip_ref.description: Path or URL to the clip segment on the node's 72h loop

native_pixels.description: True only when frames are unmodified sensor output. Evidence path requires true.

synthetic.description: True for simulator output. Synthetic media can never enter the evidence path.

dwell_s.description: Present on detection.end: total seconds in view
